text:
Anya: Quick thread to sync on postmortem follow-ups — token-count regression & delayed usage that caused late invoice corrections. Putting proposed owners and timelines below; please ack and update if you need more time.

Matt: I can own the token backfill job and verification. Targeting EOD Thursday for a dry run, full backfill by next Tue. I'll post results in this thread. :+1:

Sara: I'll own invoice adjustments and communications. Need the list of affected invoice IDs + delta per customer. Can we get that export by tomorrow noon? @Matt

Matt: Yes — I'll produce a CSV from the ledger query. Draft query I'm going to run:

```
-- identify delayed usage windows and token deltas
SELECT invoice_id, customer_id, SUM(token_delta) as delta_tokens
FROM token_events
WHERE event_ts BETWEEN '2026-03-10' AND '2026-03-11'
  AND source = 'ingest-retry-lag'
GROUP BY invoice_id, customer_id
HAVING SUM(token_delta) > 0;
```

Matt: I'll run it against staging first, then prod once Sara confirms format.

Jorge: I'll take ownership of the root cause remediation (ingest retry queue visibility). Plan: add alert on retry-queue-length > 50 and a dashboard tile for per-region backlog. ETA: PR by Friday.

Grace: I'll handle the automation to prevent double-counting during backfill (idempotency guard). Will add a job-level lock and a runbook note. ETA Monday.

eng-oncall: reminder from oncall side — if the backfill spikes ingestion, route to low-priority workers and throttle per-customer to keep API SLOs intact. We can flip the throttling flag from console.

Sara: Thanks. Also need a message template for customers who will see a credit. Draft to review:

"Hi <Customer>, we identified an ingestion delay that temporarily underreported usage for invoice <ID>. We've applied a credit of <$X> to your account. No action required. Contact billing@ if you have questions."

Anya: Please attach a list of top 20 affected customers to the customer comms (by credit amount). We should prioritize manual review for any credit > $5k.

billing-bot: Report generated: 1761114_report.csv (attached) — 316 affected invoice rows, total credits $18,420. Link: https://internal.redwood/billing/reports/1761114_report.csv

Sara: Received the CSV, starting validations now. Will post a summary of suspected false positives (should be <5%) by tomorrow noon.

Matt: Dry run completed in staging; check results at https://ci.redwood/logs/backfill/1761112223/dryrun. No duplicates, idempotency looks good.

Grace: Added runbook snippet for backfill: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/billing-backfill. Include steps for abort and rollback.

Anya: OK team — owners and ETAs: Matt (backfill + csv) EOD Thu / full Tue; Sara (invoices + comms) finish validation by tomorrow noon; Jorge (remediation alerts) PR Fri; Grace (idempotency + runbook) Mon. If any block, flag in this thread. I'll follow up in tomorrow's billing stand. :calendar:

Matt: Ack. I'll post prod-post metrics after the full run (token gap closed, per-customer diff summary).

Jorge: Ack. Will add alert with paging to SRE if backlog > 200 for > 30m.

eng-oncall: I'll standby during the run window in case we need manual throttles.

Sara: One more ask — finance needs a clear list for accounting: invoice_id, customer_id, credit_amount, reason_code. I'll link the final file to the invoice reissue ticket.

Anya: Great — thanks everyone. Filing action tracker in Notion and will link here once created. If you want to transfer ownership of any item, please mention it now. :wave:
